title: sunasty-color-math: Zero-dependency sRGB, OKLCH, and WCAG 2.1 Color Space Conversions
description: Zero-dependency algorithmic library for IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB gamma linearization, Oklab/OKLCH perceptual transformations, and WCAG 2.1 accessibility contrast calculation. Developed as the core mathematical engine for the Sunasty client-side file processing suite.
